headline: Nothing has synced since Sunday evening - the pipeline is down, not your training. Today's 6 km goes early.
body:
No data has reached me since Sunday. training.json is **37.5 hours old** and four push windows have passed without one, so there is no file for yesterday's 4 x 3 min, no gym log, and no wellness row for Monday or Tuesday. I am not calling anything missed - there is nothing to miss it with. Worth a look at the laptop.

Readiness therefore reads off **Sunday**, three mornings back: HRV **70** against a 61.0 mean, RHR **45**, your 14-day best. Green then, unknown now - so take today exactly as written and add nothing.

Today is 6 km easy, your last real run before Santos. **6:45-7:15/km at 131-150 bpm**, then 4 x 1 min at **6:30-6:50/km**. Sunday you ran 6:10/km off the bike; today is deliberately slower than that. Go before 11:00 - **62 km/h** gusts early against **73** by midday, on a forecast that is itself two days old. Treadmill at 1% transfers cleanly.

The ankle: still nothing from you since Sunday's 7.21 km. Today's run is the last read we get before the start line.
